understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by maneuvering the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked with a '+' was occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, triggering a WIN for the level and ultimately completing all levels of the KA59 run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controlled one selected piece ('P'). MOVE actions attempted to shift that selected piece by one grid step (3 pixels per cell) in the chosen direction; movement could be blocked or altered by walls/boundaries, and the movement_blocked flags were only hints rather than guarantees. If a pushable object (e.g., a block) was directly adjacent in the move direction and space allowed, the selected piece could push it along. Levels could include multiple selectables ('S'); using CLICK with an exact object position in the same coordinate system as player/objects switched which selectable was currently controlled.
